label: AUTO – automatic regulation
meaning_and_action: Automatically regulates climate; choose desired temperature and check actual mode.

label: A/C – cooling mode
meaning_and_action: Fan must run. Cooling off does not dehumidify; low temperatures can disable cooling automatically. Restore appropriate operation if windows mist.

label: OFF – whole-system shutdown
meaning_and_action: Switches climate off and closes outside-air intake; not merely A/C off. Use the equipment-specific control to restore operation.

label: A/C MAX – maximum cooling
meaning_and_action: Use briefly. Depending on actual mode and conditions, misting can occur; maintain visibility.

label: A/C eco / ECO – energy-saving cooling
meaning_and_action: A climate mode, not a drive profile or fault. Set according to cooling and visibility needs.

label: SYNC – synchronise zones
meaning_and_action: Adopts driver settings. Exceptions/end conditions depend on equipment: A4 excludes seat functions where specified and passenger/rear adjustment cancels SYNC; lower-display gesture documented only for A8.

label: MAX – demisting and defrosting
meaning_and_action: Maximum airflow towards the windscreen; recirculation is disabled and other functions can activate depending on conditions. Maintain visibility.

label: REAR with rectangle/heating lines – rear glass
meaning_and_action: With engine running, switches off after 10–20 minutes depending on outside temperature. Holding over three seconds enables until ignition off. Not rear climate control.

label: Temperature – colour markers or plus/minus
meaning_and_action: Range/adjustment follow the actual system. A4 three-zone uses LO/HI, A8 LOW/HIGH; not the same graphic variant.
publication_note: Literal display strings are documented, but no independently verified coloured display rendition was published.

label: Fan and level adjustment
meaning_and_action: Low airflow can impair ventilation/visibility; use equipment-specific AUTO for automatic regulation.

label: Air distribution – individual directions
meaning_and_action: Use the actual control to choose airflow direction. Direct side vents to glass to prevent misting. A8 distinguishes three direction arrows; A4 rotary or rocker controls.

label: Windscreen heating – separate function and flashing LED
meaning_and_action: Depending on outside temperature/equipment, heating can be automatic or manual. A flashing LED during manual activation is not automatically a fault.
publication_note: Different heating and defrost contexts retained; no unverified standalone graphic substituted.

label: Car with arrow – manual recirculation
meaning_and_action: Recirculates cabin air. Avoid prolonged use due to misting/possible CO₂ increase; switch off and ventilate if unwell.

label: Automatic recirculation / AUTO car symbol
meaning_and_action: Where equipped, regulates according to air pollution. Same recirculation precautions; not direct CO₂ measurement.

label: Seat with heating lines – heating
meaning_and_action: First press selects maximum, subsequent presses reduce. No indication means off. Reduced sensitivity creates burn risk; do not cover an operating heated surface.

label: Seat with fan – ventilation
meaning_and_action: Press repeatedly through levels, starting at maximum. Indication off means function off; not seat heating.

label: Residual heat – shared control in another context
meaning_and_action: A8: with ignition off hold MAX over two seconds. A4: press the appropriate rotary control, left on three-zone. Stops after about 15 minutes; procedures are not interchangeable.
publication_note: A4 own rotary-AUTO function now published; A8 MAX procedure is explicitly excluded.

label: A/C ON – cooling on
meaning_and_action: The exact mode is explained in the separate model-documented preview entry.

label: A/C OFF – cooling only off
meaning_and_action: The exact mode is explained in the separate model-documented preview entry.

label: SET REAR – rear settings from cockpit
meaning_and_action: The exact mode is explained in the separate model-documented preview entry.

label: 3-ZONE – synchronisation ended
meaning_and_action: Passenger/rear adjustment ends synchronisation and displays 3-ZONE. Not a climate-system fault.

label: Rear plus/minus and rear seat heating
meaning_and_action: Depends on three-zone equipment; adjusts rear temperature, separate seat button adjusts heating. Not volume.

label: Foot-sole heating

label: Rear Seat Remote child lock
meaning_and_action: Lit symbol means child lock active and controls blocked; not by itself a malfunction.

label: Ionisation
meaning_and_action: Where equipped may improve perceived freshness; both side vents must be open. Not a health guarantee.

label: Fragrance and settings
meaning_and_action: Select/intensity per manual; use approved fragrances sparingly, reduce/switch off if unwell.

label: Vents – opening and closing scale
meaning_and_action: Swipe right to open, left to close; press scale directly to select level, lever changes direction.

label: Gear – further climate settings
meaning_and_action: Vehicle > Climate > settings for installed equipment, e.g. fragrance, footwell temperature or auxiliary heating. Fuel-fired auxiliary heater emits hot exhaust.

label: Air quality – AQI or schematic filtration
meaning_and_action: Without sensor, a filter schematic; with sensor, approximate PM2.5/AQI, green very good. Not interchangeable with CO₂, other values or instruments. Conditions limit readings.

label: LO – extreme setting
meaning_and_action: Lower extreme means continuous maximum cooling, not measured cabin temperature.
publication_note: Literal setting string and meaning are confirmed; an exact coloured display rendition is not established by this paragraph and is not invented.

label: HI – extreme setting
meaning_and_action: Upper extreme means continuous maximum heating, not measured cabin temperature.

label: LOW – extreme setting
meaning_and_action: Lower extreme means continuous maximum cooling, not measured cabin temperature.

meaning_and_action: First direction sends air to the windscreen. Use AUTO or deselect all three arrows as instructed for automatic regulation.
